summary: This RFC changes the registration policy for several registries in the IANA PCEP Numbers group from Standards Action to IETF Review, and it allows experimental error codes. It updates a long list of earlier PCEP RFCs to match. The goal is to make it easier to get new values assigned.

eli5.summary: A club had a rule that only a vote of every member could add a new item to its list. This loosens the rule so adding things is easier, and leaves room for experiments.
